motionResult.title: Motion ready
motionResult.revised: Applied to the Motion you selected, at {time}.
motionResult.proposed: Waiting for your decision before it is placed.
motionResult.draftReady: Open it in Motion to look at it or keep editing.
motionResult.notPlaced: Saved to My Motions, but not placed on the video: {reason}.

reasons.composition_tools_closed: the assistant cannot edit projects for this workspace
reasons.timeline_empty: the project has no scene yet
reasons.timeline_unresolved: a scene has no length yet
reasons.scene_too_short: the scene is too short for it
reasons.ratio_not_available: it does not fit this canvas format
reasons.refused: the project could not take it
reasons.conflict: the project changed in the meantime

motionResult.undone: Undone. The Motion is still in My Motions.
motionResult.undoConflict: You changed the project since then. Use Undo in the editor.
